0022600106.text: The 76ers (2-0, 1st in the Atlantic) host the Milwaukee Bucks (0-2, 13th in the East) in Philadelphia's third game of the season, with the 76ers riding a two-game win streak while Milwaukee has lost two straight. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and Dean Wade (ankle, sprain) and LeBron James (back) are listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the 76ers won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026.
